name: hourglass

source.prompt: One realistic nineteenth-century tabletop hourglass, clear double-lobed glass with fine neutral gray sand in both bulbs, dark brushed-nickel structural columns and matte pearl metal circular end caps. Frontal, upright, balanced vertically, top and bottom completely visible. No stand outside the instrument.

method: Use aligned region mask and original neutral luminance. Model used neutral top-left light. Diffuse = min(1,1.2*luma^0.74), specular shoulder above .80, preserve original alpha and unmasked pixels. Region construction is recorded in palette.ts.
